lines.en: label christmasimani2:
scene imanitree1
: No, idiot. A huge, lit-up tree.
lines.zh: 不是，笨蛋。是一棵巨大的、亮着灯的树。

lines.en: : Oh, neat. But did you really have to stay silent the whole way here just so you could clap back at me with that response?
lines.zh: 哦，不错。不过你真的有必要一路上一句话都不说，就为了憋出这么一句来怼我吗？

lines.en: : Anything for the bit, Imani. Our fans would love this.
lines.zh: 为了节目效果什么都值，Imani。我们的粉丝会爱死这个的。

lines.en: : The fact that we have fans at all is kind of impressive given that nothing we’ve ever done has been televised or publicly available anywhere.
lines.zh: 考虑到我们做过的事从来没上过电视、也没在任何地方公开过，我们居然还有粉丝，这本身就挺了不起的。

lines.en: : That’d be crazy, though. Right? If we were just part of some TV show or movie this entire time and didn’t even know about it.
lines.zh: 不过那也太疯狂了吧。对吧？要是我们从头到尾都是某个电视节目或电影里的一部分，自己还完全不知道。

lines.en: : Oh, like the Truman Show! That sounds fun. I hope they censored the foursome scene, though. I wouldn’t want Kirin masturbating to it.
lines.zh: 哦，就像《楚门的世界》！听起来挺有意思的。不过我希望他们把那段四人性交的戏给剪了。我可不想让 Kirin 对着它打飞机。

lines.en: : You know, I feel like that would actually explain a lot about being here. The barriers...the space war...the fact that there {i}always{/i} needs to be something tragic happening. This really does feel like the setup to a film.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我觉得这其实能解释这里很多事。那些屏障……太空战争……还有{i}永远{/i}得发生点悲剧这件事。这里真的像极了一部电影的设定。

lines.en: : Does that make me the love interest then?
lines.zh: 那我岂不就是恋爱对象了？

lines.en: : Why not the protagonist?
lines.zh: 为什么不能是主角？

lines.en: : Me? A biracial, bisexual woman? Are you kidding? Just think of what Twitter would say.
lines.zh: 我？一个混血的双性恋女人？你开玩笑吧？想想 Twitter 上会怎么说。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re right. I hesitate to call myself a safer bet concerning anything other than ratings, though. But maybe one day- when the writer in charge of us no longer feels beholden to the masses.
lines.zh: 嗯，你说得对。不过除了收视率以外，我可不敢说自己在别的方面是更保险的选择。不过也许有一天——等掌管我们的编剧不再觉得要对大众负责的时候。

lines.en: : So that’s it then? We’re just accepting the Truman Show as our new reality?
lines.zh: 那就这么定了？我们就这么把《楚门的世界》当成我们的新现实了？

lines.en: : Yeah. Start looking for a door built into the sky or something. I’m about ready for the credits to roll.
lines.zh: 对。开始找找看天上有没有一扇门之类的吧。我已经准备好等字幕滚动了。

lines.en: That huge, lit-up tree smiles down at us in all of its Christmassy glory, but we’re too focused on feeding off one another to realize it.
lines.zh: 那棵巨大的、亮着灯的树以它全部的圣诞光辉俯视着我们，可我们太专注于互相汲取，根本没注意到。

lines.en: I know it’s only been a couple hours at this point, but I’m having fun. Imani’s great when it comes to adapting to whatever mood I’m in. And that makes it easier to find comfort in borderline nothingness.
lines.zh: 我知道这才过了几个小时，但我很开心。Imani 很擅长配合我当下的任何心情。这让我更容易在这种近乎虚无的状态里找到安慰。

lines.en: But maybe that’s {i}because{/i} she’s my co-star in this new rom-com of a life. They wouldn’t have cast someone who didn’t have good chemistry with me.
lines.zh: 不过也许正{i}因为{/i}她是我这部新浪漫喜剧人生的搭档。他们不会选一个跟我没默契的人来演。

lines.en: It all feels too real to be {i}just that,{/i} though. Which is why I can joke about things like doors in the sky and ratings and whatnot as a staged reality would be far too convenient to ever be true.
lines.zh: 可这一切都太真实了，不可能{i}只是{/i}那样。所以我才会拿天上的门、收视率之类的东西开玩笑——被安排好的现实太省事了，不可能是真的。

lines.en: Imagine it {i}was,{/i} though.
lines.zh: 不过，想象一下它{i}真的{/i}是那样。

lines.en: Imagine we did find a door. And the moment I passed through it, everyone I’ve ever come to know just smiled and collected their paycheck — leaving me to fend for myself outside my lifelong bassinet.
lines.zh: 想象我们真的找到了一扇门。我一穿过去，所有我认识的人都只是微笑着领走他们的片酬——把我一个人丢在我待了一辈子的摇篮外自生自灭。

lines.en: I’d be helpless out there. It’d be hilarious. But still...I think I’d be open to giving it a shot.
lines.zh: 我在外面会完全无助。那会很搞笑。不过……我觉得我愿意试一试。

lines.en: A world where no one loves me sounds nice. I’m sure I’d be saying the opposite if the tables were turned, though.
lines.zh: 一个没人爱我的世界听起来挺好的。不过要是情况反过来，我肯定会说相反的话。

lines.en: It’s easy to want what you don’t have when there’s a permanent baseline of misery stretched across the metaphorical floor of your metaphorical existence.
lines.zh: 当你那比喻意义上的存在、其比喻意义上的地板上永远铺着一层痛苦时，想要自己没有的东西是很容易的。

lines.en: And I think I’d spend a little less time tripping over it if I could be distracted by the need to {i}find{/i} a companion rather than just waiting for one to come to me.
lines.zh: 而且我想，如果我能被「{i}去找{/i}一个伴」这件事分散注意力，而不是干等着一个伴自己找上门，我就不会老是绊倒在上面。

lines.en: I wonder how someone like Imani {i}would{/i} view me outside of Kumon-mi. Would all those red flags I mentioned earlier push her away? Or would they obscure me {i}just enough{/i} to make me look approachable?
lines.zh: 我好奇的是，在 Kumon-mi 之外，像 Imani 这样的人会怎么看我。我之前提到的那些危险信号会把她推开吗？还是会把我遮得{i}恰到好处{/i}，让我看起来更好接近？

lines.en: scene imanitree2
If they did...I think she’d have a better shot out there.
lines.zh: 如果是后者……我觉得她在外面的机会更大。

lines.en: I think I’d be more inclined to latch onto this feeling and never let it go than I am in this world. Because on the outside, I’m not saying I wouldn’t have seven billion choices.
lines.zh: 我觉得我会比在这个世界里更想抓住这种感觉、永远不撒手。因为在外面，我不是说自己不会有七十亿个选择。

lines.en: I’m saying I’d lack the patience to sift through them all with the looming threat of mortality weighing me down.
lines.zh: 我是说，在死亡的阴影压着我的时候，我没那个耐心把它们一个个筛过去。

lines.en: She’s the easiest way for me to start over.
lines.zh: 她是我重新开始的最省事的途径。

lines.en: I’ve just come so far here that doing so would feel like one sin I could never pray away.
lines.zh: 只是我在这里已经走了这么远，这么做会像是一桩我怎么祈祷都赎不掉的罪。

lines.en: : I think this is the part where you say that clichéd line about how “the moon is beautiful” or whatever.
lines.zh: 我觉得现在该你说那句老套台词了，什么「今晚的月色真美」之类的。

lines.en: : Nah. If this really is a movie, I’m sure that’s already been used by now.
lines.zh: 算了吧。如果这真是一部电影，那句肯定早就被用烂了。

lines.en: scene imanitree3
: Maybe hit me with the good ole’ Casablanca then? {i}Here’s looking at you, kid...{/i}or however it goes.
lines.zh: 那要不来句经典的《卡萨布兰卡》？{i}永志难忘，孩子……{/i}还是怎么说的来着。

lines.en: : I’m not even sure that would fit the context of this scene since there’s no pressing threat of me leaving you behind.
lines.zh: 我都不确定这句合不合这场戏的语境，毕竟我并不急着要抛下你。

lines.en: : Well, that’s comforting. Because finding another guy in Kumon-mi sounds way too hard and I don’t think I could settle for Rika given the age gap.
lines.zh: 嗯，这话听着让人安心。因为在 Kumon-mi 再找一个男人听起来太难了，而且考虑到年龄差，我可不觉得我能将就 Rika。

lines.en: : There’s a bit of an age gap between us too, you know.
lines.zh: 我们俩之间也有点年龄差啊，你知道的。

lines.en: : Naaah. Ours is realistic. And by the time I hit menopause, you’ll probably already have a bad back and won’t be able to screw me as hard anyway.
lines.zh: 才不呢。我们这个差距才现实。而且等我到了更年期，你大概早就腰坏了，反也没法那么用力干我了。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearing is that we belong together because we’re both going to start physically decaying around the same time?
lines.zh: 那我听到的就是：我们之所以该在一起，是因为我们会差不多同时开始身体衰退？

lines.en: : Yeah, pretty much. But I think there’s a lot more than just that that makes us work. Assuming you ever want to actually go out with me and not just hit it all the time.
lines.zh: 对，差不多。不过我觉得让我们合得来的远不止这个。前提是你哪天真的想跟我约会，而不是一直只想上床。

lines.en: : Sorry, Imani. Kumon-mi High prohibits me from dating a coworker. Probably.
lines.zh: 抱歉，Imani。Kumon-mi 高中禁止我和同事交往。大概吧。

lines.en: : He says, despite having not been my co-worker since prior to last Christmas.
lines.zh: 他说这话，尽管他从去年圣诞节之前就已经不是我同事了。

lines.en: : I’m still your superior on paper, though. And that paper may very well be shredded the moment the principal finds out we come into contact with one another’s genitals on occasion.
lines.zh: 不过在纸面上我还是你的上司。而且等校长发现我们偶尔会接触彼此的生殖器，那张纸很可能立刻就会被粉碎。

lines.en: : You have such a way with words, Senpai. Staring up at the moon while hearing you talk about genitals is really making my heart flutter.
lines.zh: 你真会说话，Senpai。一边抬头看月亮一边听你聊生殖器，真是让我小鹿乱撞。

lines.en: : I’d say that just looking at you is making mine do that, but I feel like I wouldn’t be able to see you at all if it weren’t for the bright yellow outfit you’re wearing.
lines.zh: 我也想说光是看着你就让我心跳加速，不过我觉得要不是你穿着那身亮黄色的衣服，我根本就看不见你。

lines.en: scene imanitree4
: I strategically chose this so you wouldn’t lose me. Seems it’s paying off in spades, huh?
lines.zh: 我特意挑这件就是为了让你不会跟丢我。看来效果拔群啊，对吧？

lines.en: : Seems so. Are you still having a good time now that I’ve pulled you all the way over here to talk about movies and age gaps, though?
lines.zh: 看起来是。不过我把你一路拉到这儿来聊电影和年龄差，你现在还玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Or should we start winding this down because I get progressively more unlikable with every passing minute?
lines.zh: 还是说我们该收尾了，因为我每过一分钟就变得更讨人厌一点？

lines.en: scene imanitree5
: That ain’t true, Senpai. My feelings for you are kind of peaking right now if we’re being honest. Which we probably shouldn’t since I know you want to keep me as a friend. But yeah. You’re great.
lines.zh: 才不是呢，Senpai。说实话，我现在对你的好感大概正处在顶点。虽然我们大概不该说实话，因为我知道你想只把我当朋友。不过呢。你很棒。

lines.en: : If you really want me to date you, you’re going to have to stop complimenting me. The quickest way to my heart seems to be just bossing me around and reminding me of how much I suck all the time.
lines.zh: 如果你真想让我跟你交往，你得别再夸我了。通往我心的捷径似乎就是对我指手画脚、时刻提醒我有多烂。

lines.en: : You like Wakana that much, huh?
lines.zh: 你那么喜欢 Wakana 啊？

lines.en: : That’s...not who I was thinking of. But yeah, I guess it does apply to her too. She’d also be a good match for me if she hadn’t spent her whole life banging a would-be Olympian.
lines.zh: 我……想的不是她。不过是啊，这大概对她也适用。要是她没把一辈子都耗在跟一个准奥运选手上床这件事上，她也会是适合我的人。

lines.en: : Now’s the best chance you have to steal her, you know.
lines.zh: 现在可是你把她抢走的最好时机，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Imani, come on.
lines.zh: Imani，别闹了。

lines.en: : What? I’m not {i}endorsing{/i} it. I love Osako.
lines.zh: 怎么？我可没有{i}支持{/i}这事。我爱 Osako。

lines.en: : I’m just saying, if you {i}really{/i} think she’d be a good match for you...and you think screwing {i}her{/i} for the rest of forever would bring you happiness...what are you waiting for?
lines.zh: 我只是说，如果你{i}真的{/i}觉得她适合你……而且你觉得这辈子都跟{i}她{/i}上床会让你幸福……那你还在等什么？

lines.en: : Are you telling me you’d betray your friends if it brought {i}you{/i} closer to happiness?
lines.zh: 你是说，只要能让{i}你{/i}更接近幸福，你愿意背叛朋友？

lines.en: : It’s not about {i}betraying{/i} them, Senpai. It’s about doing what’s best for you.
lines.zh: 这不是{i}背叛{/i}他们的问题，Senpai。这是做对你最好的事。

lines.en: : No one {i}likes{/i} letting other people down. But it still happens every day because it kind of {i}has{/i} to for anyone to ever get what they want.
lines.zh: 没人{i}喜欢{/i}让别人失望。可这种事每天都在发生，因为要想有人得到自己想要的，它{i}必须{/i}发生。

lines.en: : Otherwise, we’d have a bunch of people running around with unfulfilled wishes — dwelling on “what ifs” and “what could have beens” instead of focusing on where they are now. And with whom.
lines.zh: 不然的话，就会有一大群人带着未了的心愿到处跑——纠结于「如果当初」和「本可以」，而不是专注于此刻身在何处。以及和谁在一起。

lines.en: : I guess that explains why you’ve always been so open about your feelings for me then.
lines.zh: 那我猜这也能解释，你为什么一直都这么坦率地表达对我的感情。

lines.en: scene imanitree6
: Not {i}always.{/i} It took me a while to summon the courage to confess to you — if you even want to call it that. I’m just better at reasoning than I am at {i}acting.{/i}
lines.zh: 也不是{i}一直{/i}。我花了很久才鼓起勇气向你表白——如果你还想管那叫表白的话。我只是更擅长讲道理，而不是{i}行动{/i}。

lines.en: : Then I guess we’ve found one thing we {i}don’t{/i} have in common since I’m the exact opposite. Acting, I can do. But rationalizing even the simplest things feels like a mental obstacle course some days.
lines.zh: 那我想我们终于找到一件{i}不{/i}一样的地方了，因为我正好相反。行动，我行。可有时候光是要把最简单的事讲出个道理，都像在跑一场脑力障碍赛。

lines.en: scene imanitree7
: Maybe you need a change of pace then?
lines.zh: 那也许你需要换个节奏？

lines.en: : Is this the part where you proclaim that {i}you{/i} can be that change of pace? Because it would be a good time for that.
lines.zh: 现在是不是该你宣称{i}你{/i}就是那个新节奏了？因为现在正是好时机。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: : Just not in the way you’re probably thinking.
lines.zh: 只是可能不是你在想的那种方式。

lines.en: scene imanitree8
: Hm?
lines.zh: 嗯？

lines.en: : What would you say if I told you I had a solution to like a million of your problems in the palm of my hands, but I was intentionally not revealing it because I didn’t want to {i}betray{/i} anyone?
lines.zh: 如果我告诉你，我手心里握着能解决你大概一百万个麻烦的办法，但我故意不说出来，因为我不想{i}背叛{/i}任何人，你会怎么说？

lines.en: : I’d say that’s a convenient turn of events and extremely topical given what we were discussing one minute ago. And also that it is likely not true.
lines.zh: 我会说这转折来得真巧，而且就在我们一分钟前聊的话题上，实在太应景了。另外我会说这大概不是真的。

lines.en: : Are you happier now that you’re not teaching anymore, Senpai?
lines.zh: 你现在不当老师了，是不是更开心了，Senpai？

lines.en: scene imanitree9
: Not...really? But there are also several other factors contributing to that. And it certainly doesn’t help always worrying about having to come back.
lines.zh: 也……不算吧？不过还有好几个别的因素在里面。而且老是担心得回去，肯定也没什么帮助。

lines.en: : Wakana gave you a deadline, right? The...beginning of the next school year or something?
lines.zh: Wakana 给了你一个期限，对吧？……下学年开始什么的？

lines.en: : It’s not really the deadline I’m worried about. It’s that {i}I’m{/i} constantly letting everyone down by postponing my return over and over again.
lines.zh: 我担心的其实不是那个期限。而是{i}我{/i}一而再、再而三地推迟回去，一直在让所有人失望。

lines.en: : It’s not just Wakana either. You add to it. The girls add to it. And then {i}I{/i} add to it on those early mornings where I just wander around town remembering where I’m {i}supposed{/i} to be.
lines.zh: 也不只是 Wakana。你也算一份。那些女孩也算。然后{i}我{/i}自己也算——在那些一大早漫无目的地在城里乱逛、想起自己{i}本该{/i}在哪儿的清晨。

lines.en: : But I’m afraid of coming back because I don’t think it will {i}fix{/i} that creeping dread of never going anywhere...Or the repetition of living through the same days over and over again.
lines.zh: 可我害怕回去，因为我不觉得那能{i}治好{/i}那种永远原地踏步的隐隐恐惧……也治不好日复一日过着同样日子的那种重复。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even mentioning how you’re a better teacher than I ever was.
lines.zh: 就更别提你比我当老师当得好多了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. There’s a lot wrong with my life right now, and even more is changing. And I probably would’ve come back to school already if I thought that was the key to changing that.
lines.zh: 我不知道。我现在的生活有很多不对劲的地方，还有更多正在改变。如果我觉得回学校是改变这一切的关键，我大概早就回去了。

lines.en: : Why not just rip the Band-aid off then?
lines.zh: 那为什么不干脆把创可贴一把撕掉？

lines.en: : Why not quit?
lines.zh: 为什么不干脆辞职？

lines.en: scene imanitree10
: You don’t actually-
lines.zh: 你该不会真的——

lines.en: : I think you should do what’s best for {i}you.{/i} And I think that Wakana and I have both been way too selfish in pushing you to come back because that’s what {i}we{/i} want.
lines.zh: 我觉得你该做对{i}你{/i}最好的事。而且我觉得 Wakana 和我都太自私了，一直逼你回来，只因为那是{i}我们{/i}想要的。

lines.en: : We miss you. You know that. But, and I know you’re going to disagree with this, neither one of us knows you as well as {i}you{/i} do.
lines.zh: 我们想你。这你知道。可是——我知道你不会同意——我们俩谁都不如{i}你{/i}自己了解你。

lines.en: : We can tell ourselves we know what’s best for you, sure. So can all of the girls. But if you’re living with the constant pressure of having to return to school...and that’s {i}killing{/i} you?
lines.zh: 我们当然可以告诉自己我们知道什么对你最好。那些女孩也可以。可如果你一直活在必须回学校的压力之下……而那正在{i}杀死{/i}你呢？

lines.en: : Just stop.
lines.zh: 那就停下来。

lines.en: : It’s okay to walk away, Senpai. Responsibility is one thing, yeah. But an even {i}bigger{/i} thing is figuring out what the hell you want to do with your life.
lines.zh: 走开是可以的，Senpai。责任是一回事，没错。但{i}更{/i}重要的一件事，是搞清楚你到底想拿自己这辈子干什么。

lines.en: : And, being someone who actually {i}likes{/i} teaching, I’m not sure that {i}this{/i} is right for you.
lines.zh: 而且作为一个真的{i}喜欢{/i}教书的人，我不确定{i}这{/i}适合你。

lines.en: scene imanitree11
: You’re just saying that because you’re gunning for my job.
lines.zh: 你这么说只是因为你在盯着我的职位。

lines.en: : No, Senpai. I’m not.
lines.zh: 不是的，Senpai。我不是。

lines.en: : Then...you’re just saying it because it cancels out that thing I said earlier about not dating coworkers.
lines.zh: 那么……你这么说是因为它能抵掉我之前说的那句不和同事交往的话。

lines.en: : No, Senpai. I’m-
lines.zh: 不是的，Senpai。我——

lines.en: : Well, actually, that one’s true.
lines.zh: 嗯，好吧，那一条倒是真的。

lines.en: scene imanitree12
: But that’s still not the point!
lines.zh: 可重点还是不在这儿！

lines.en: : At the end of the day, all I really want is for you to {i}not{/i} feel like every day is just a repeat of the one before it.
lines.zh: 说到底，我真正想要的，只是让你{i}别{/i}觉得每一天都只是前一天的重复。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve got very bad news for you.
lines.zh: 嗯，那我要告诉你一个非常坏的消息。

lines.en: : Like 40%% of your personality is having bad news. You’re constantly talking yourself out of {i}everything{/i} that could potentially bring you joy.
lines.zh: 你性格里大概有 40%% 都是坏消息。你总是在说服自己放弃{i}任何{/i}可能带给你快乐的东西。

lines.en: : But school seems to be like the one thing you talk yourself {i}into{/i} that doesn’t bring you joy. And it feels like you’re only there because you believe that’s where you’re meant to be.
lines.zh: 可学校似乎是你唯一会说服自己{i}去做{/i}、却不会带给你快乐的事。而且感觉你留在那儿，只是因为你相信那才是你该在的地方。

lines.en: scene imanitree13
: Wakana would kill me for saying this and...I kind of hate {i}myself{/i} for it since it feels like I’m convincing you to spend {i}less{/i} time with me...
lines.zh: Wakana 听到这话会杀了我的，而且……我还有点{i}恨自己{/i}，因为这感觉像是在劝你{i}少{/i}花时间陪我……

lines.en: : But maybe the time we spend together will be {i}more{/i} fulfilling without that creeping dread latching onto your ankles the whole time?
lines.zh: 不过也许，要是那种隐隐的恐惧不再一直缠在你的脚踝上，我们相处的时间反而会{i}更{/i}让人满足？

lines.en: : I don’t really get {i}religious{/i} often, but there’s a quote from the Bible that’s like...
lines.zh: 我其实不常{i}信教{/i}，不过《圣经》里有句话是这么说的……

lines.en: : “When times are good, be happy; but when times are bad, consider — God has made the one as well as the other. Therefore, a man cannot discover anything about his future.”
lines.zh: 「遇亨通的日子，你当喜乐；遭患难的日子，你当思想；因为神使这两样并列，为的是叫人查不出身后有什么事。」

lines.en: : “In this meaningless life of mine I have seen both of these: a righteous man perishing in his righteousness, and a wicked man living long in his wickedness.”
lines.zh: 「有义人行义，反致灭亡；有恶人行恶，倒享长寿。」

lines.en: : “Do not be overrighteous, neither be overwise-- why destroy yourself? Do not be overwicked, and do not be a fool-- why die before your time?”
lines.zh: 「不要行义过分，也不要过于自逞智慧，何必自取败亡呢？不要行恶过分，也不要为人愚昧，何必不到期而死呢？」

lines.en: : That’s a really long quote to remember for someone who doesn’t get religious very often.
lines.zh: 对一个不常信教的人来说，你记的这段话可真够长的。

lines.en: scene imanitree14
: Yeah, well...I’ve heard it a thousand times, so...
lines.zh: 嗯，是啦……我听过一千遍了，所以……

lines.en: : Either way, I don’t want you to dwell on this shit for so long that you turn into some giant ball of uncertainty and negativity. I want you to {i}live.{/i} And I want you to {i}let{/i} yourself live.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我不想你在这堆破事上纠结太久，最后变成一坨巨大的不确定和负能量。我要你{i}活着{/i}。我要你{i}允许{/i}自己活着。

lines.en: : So if that means cutting certain cords...even {i}if{/i} those cords are connected to all of us who care about you...maybe that’s what needs to be done? Do you see what I mean?
lines.zh: 所以如果这意味着要斩断某些羁绊……{i}即便{/i}那些羁绊连着我们这些在乎你的人……也许那正是该做的事？你明白我的意思吗？

lines.en: : I do. But, question — is this one of those things you’ve been thinking about for longer than you let on? Or did all of this {i}really{/i} just come to you now?
lines.zh: 我明白。不过，问一句——这是你早就想了很久、只是没说出来的事吗？还是说这一切{i}真的{/i}是刚想到的？

lines.en: scene imanitree15
: Beats me! Anyway, here’s a present.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢！总之，给你件礼物。

lines.en: : Where were you even keeping this? And why do I suddenly not feel the need to further press you about that thing I just asked?
lines.zh: 你到底把它藏在哪儿的？还有，我怎么突然就不想再追问刚才那个问题了？

lines.en: scene imanitree16
: Probably because you’ve already come up with an answer. Don’t worry, though. I’m not going to make you reveal it tonight. Take as much time as you need.
lines.zh: 大概是因为你已经有答案了。不过别担心。我不会逼你今晚就说出来。你需要多久都行。

lines.en: : Can I open this now or are you going to make me wait until I get home?
lines.zh: 我现在能拆吗，还是你要我等到回家再拆？

lines.en: : You can open it now. Fair warning, though — I am just as bad at gift-giving as I am asking people out on dates. Please see it as “endearing” rather than “careless.”
lines.zh: 现在就能拆。不过先说好——我送礼物的水平和约人出去的水平一样烂。请把这当成「可爱」，而不是「不上心」。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s fine. I understand that I’m a hard person to shop for.
lines.zh: 我肯定没问题。我知道给我买礼物挺难的。

lines.en: : Also, in lieu of giving {i}me{/i} a present, you can just fuck me or whatever. Rain check, though.
lines.zh: 还有，你不用送{i}我{/i}礼物，干我就行什么的。不过得改天。

lines.en: scene imanitree17
: Imani.
lines.zh: Imani。

lines.en: : I know, I know. Your balls must be blue as hell having to suffer through my apparent “peak cuteness.” But I cannot control the clock, Senpai. This is merely a side-effect of the cruel joke that is {i}humanity.{/i}
lines.zh: 我知道，我知道。忍着我这「可爱巅峰」你肯定憋得蛋疼。可我控制不了时间啊，Senpai。这不过是{i}人类{/i}这个残酷玩笑的副作用而已。

lines.en: scene imanitree18
: No, Imani. This is a pocketknife.
lines.zh: 不，Imani。这是一把折叠刀。

lines.en: : Yeah. Cool, right?
lines.zh: 对啊。挺酷的吧？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}sure?{/i} But this is more of a Noriko gift than one for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: 我是说……{i}算是吧？{/i}不过这更像是给 Noriko 的礼物，而不是给{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : Noriko’s the one who helped me pick it out, actually.
lines.zh: 其实这把是 Noriko 帮我挑的。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Bro, you said it yourself. You ain’t easy to shop for. And the Internet says dudes in their thirties like pocketknives.
lines.zh: 老兄，你自己说的啊。给你买礼物很难。而且网上说三十多岁的男人喜欢折叠刀。

lines.en: : It was either that or craft soap, and I wasn’t about to drop 5,000 yen on showers I ain’t allowed to join you for.
lines.zh: 要么这个，要么手工皂，而我又不能跟你一起洗澡，犯不着为了那个花五千日元。

lines.en: scene imanitree19
: What am I going to do with it?...
lines.zh: 我要这玩意儿干嘛？……

lines.en: : Give it to Ami! She was having a {i}damn{/i} good time cutting through some meat earlier. She’ll know what to do with it.
lines.zh: 给 Ami 啊！她刚才切肉切得{i}可{/i}开心了。她知道该拿它干什么。

lines.en: scene amisfunpartynight38
scene imanitree20
: You good, Senpai? Should I have gotten the soap instead?
lines.zh: 你还好吗，Senpai？我是不是该买那块肥皂？

lines.en: : I’m good.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: scene black
: Just...
lines.zh: 只是……

lines.en: : Felt like I was about to remember something...
lines.zh: 感觉我好像马上就要想起什么了……

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
We stayed there and stared at the tree for another thirty minutes or so, talking more about whether or not I should come back to school.
lines.zh: 我们又在那儿对着那棵树看了大概三十分钟，继续聊我到底该不该回学校。

lines.en: And honestly, I don’t know yet.
lines.zh: 老实说，我还没想好。

lines.en: Imani brought up a lot of good points, but...
lines.zh: Imani 提了很多有道理的点，不过……

lines.en: If {i}that’s{/i} not what I want to spend my life doing, what {i}should{/i} I do?
lines.zh: 如果{i}那{/i}不是我想花一辈子去做的事，那我{i}该{/i}做什么？

lines.en: What else {i}could{/i} I do?
lines.zh: 我还能{i}做{/i}什么别的？

lines.en: If what I’ve learned is true, which I’m pretty sure it is, teaching is essentially all I’ve ever done.
lines.zh: 如果我学到的是真的——我很确定是真的——那教书基本上就是我这辈子做过的全部。

lines.en: Granted, I {i}do{/i} currently have an eternity to take up something else, so...
lines.zh: 当然，我现在{i}确实{/i}有永恒的时间去干点别的，所以……

lines.en: I don’t know. I’ll think more about it later. And I’ll have plenty of time to do so, seeing as Imani is too biologically impaired to invite me back to her place to {i}really{/i} end our date tonight.
lines.zh: 我不知道。以后再想吧。而且我有的是时间想——反正 Imani 生理上不方便，今晚没法邀请我回她家，给这次约会来个{i}真正的{/i}收尾。

lines.en: She seemed fine with it, though.
lines.zh: 不过她看起来倒是无所谓。

lines.en: scene imanitree21
: {i}{b}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!{/i}{/b}
lines.zh: {i}{b}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！{/i}{/b}

lines.en: : {i}{b}TONIGHT TOTALLY WOULD HAVE BEEN THE NIGHT!!!!!! CURSE THIS BODY!!!! CURSE THIS WORLD!!!! HOW LONG MUST I REMAIN UNFUCKED FOR?!?!?!{/b}
lines.zh: {i}{b}今晚本来就该是那一天！！！！！！诅咒这具身体！！！！诅咒这个世界！！！！我到底还要多久才能被人操一次？！？！？！{/b}

lines.en: : {i}Uhh, Imani? Everything okay in there?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}呃，Imani？你那边还好吗？{/i}

lines.en: And I’m sure she’s already over it by now as there will be plenty more opportunities for me to annihilate her lower body in the future.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定她现在早就缓过来了，毕竟以后我多得是机会把她的下半身彻底摧毁。
